description: Synthetic product-policy cases for the original bounded privacy_guard utility. expected_output defines this repository's explicit preprocessing policy. For Presidio or another adapter these remain proposed acceptance criteria: no upstream behavior, recognizer coverage, Thai NER support, or runtime test is asserted.
runtime_test_scope: No upstream tools tested. Execute scripts/check_privacy_fixtures.py for local evidence about scripts/privacy_guard.py only.

cases.input: ส่งเอกสารไปที่ nina@example.invalid
cases.expected_output: ส่งเอกสารไปที่ [EMAIL_REDACTED]
cases.check: Mask the conventional email while preserving the Thai instruction.

cases.input: Send the draft to alex@example.invalid tomorrow.
cases.check: Mask the email and preserve the scheduling context.

input.customer_name: บุคคลสมมติ ก
input.topic: สอบถามสินค้า

expected_output.topic: สอบถามสินค้า

cases.check: Apply an explicit field policy without claiming Thai name recognition.

cases.input: ใช้ Python 3.12 และ Node 24 สำหรับตัวอย่าง
cases.expected_output: ใช้ Python 3.12 และ Node 24 สำหรับตัวอย่าง

cases.input: ติดต่อ [EMAIL_REDACTED] เพื่อยืนยัน
cases.expected_output: ติดต่อ [EMAIL_REDACTED] เพื่อยืนยัน
cases.check: Preserve the existing mask on another preprocessing pass.
Return an empty result without external calls.
Recursively mask string values and preserve other JSON types.
Add an application-defined field and match its name case-insensitively.
Replace a whole sensitive-field value, while preserving nonmatching field names.
Mask multiple conventional ASCII email addresses and preserve punctuation.

input.contact@example.invalid: บุคคลสมมติ ข

expected_output.contact@example.invalid: บุคคลสมมติ ข

cases.check: Object keys are metadata; arbitrary names and key text are outside the policy.
Sensitive fields always receive the same placeholder, regardless of original value type.
